mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_bills (company_id, job_id, shift_id, worker_id, worker_name, shift_date, start_time, end_time, total_hours, rate_type, rate_amount, scheduled_pay, actual_pay, serial_number, third_party_serial_no, third_party_platform, status, paid_at) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{jobId}, #{shiftId}, #{workerId}, #{workerName}, #{shiftDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{totalHours}, #{rateType}, #{rateAmount}, #{scheduledPay}, #{actualPay}, #{serialNumber}, #{thirdPartySerialNo}, #{thirdPartyPlatform}, #{status}, #{paidAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_bills WHERE shift_id = #{shiftId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_bills SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
